tickets.title: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability coverage
tickets.text: Coordinate new homeowners insurance and liability coverage for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's Portland townhouse purchase, replacing their current renters-only policy set to address the changed property and liability exposure.

tickets.title: Review taxable ETF tax lots for closing cash
tickets.text: Review tax lots for taxable ETF positions in the Velvet Acorn Custody joint brokerage account to identify holdings with short-term gains versus lower-gain long-term lots that may be most suitable for liquidation to fund closing cash for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk.
tickets.evidence: Lena noted that several taxable ETF positions have both short-term gain lots and lower-gain long-term lots, affecting which holdings may be most suitable if brokerage assets are used for closing cash; the agreed tax-lot review is due 2025-10-09.
